Ann McKechin (born 22 April 1961) [ 1 ] is a former British Labour Party politician and was Member of Parliament (MP) for Glasgow Maryhill from 2001 until 2005 and Glasgow North from 2005 to 2015 . She was a junior minister under Gordon Brown before becoming a member of Miliband shadow cabinet . She lost her seat to the Scottish National Party in the landslide at the 2015 general election .
